text: After learning I had an escrow shortage, I chose to pay the shortage in full on XX/XX/2023, per the information provided to me at the time of my annual escrow analysis. While RoundPoint applied this payment to my escrow account, they have not changed my monthly payment to account for the fact that I have made this payment- despite the fact that their FAQ document included in the escrow analysis stated that " Your scheduled monthly payment will no longer include the shortage collection amount should you choose to pay the shortage in full. '' It has now been 3 additional monthly payments ( XXXX, XXXX, XXXX ) where they continue to include the Escrow shortage amount on my monthly payment. On XX/XX/2023, I emailed RoundPoint Mortgage Servicing about this escrow payment and how my monthly payment has not yet been updated. Their automatic response said they would respond within 30 business days. After not hearing from RoundPoint, I emailed them again the week of XX/XX/XXXX. I still have not received any response, to either my first or second inquiry.
